_comment: The storyboard and the words of the App Store screenshots, per platform: one entry per screenshot, in App Store order. capture: the app screen (Scripts/capture.sh, or Scripts/capture-mac.sh for the Mac); layout (one for every language, or per language): portrait, landscape (the device turned, chips below), rise (the device larger, rising from the bottom edge, which cuts the screen where its content ends; see rise) or wide (Mac, Apple TV); chips: short glass labels over the picture (a null for a language leaves the label out in it); bubble (Siri) and bubble_at: its place, a fraction of the device's height; rise: cut (the fraction of the capture's height at the bottom edge), screen_width, chip_size, cover_from (black from there to the cut); inset (Mac): another capture, cropped (x, y, width, height in pixels) and enlarged on a card over the device, centered at `at` (fractions of the screen), with a label. compose.py reads it. A platform can derive its set from another: from (the platform), skip (ids), override (fields by id).
